title: Zero Re-render Form State Engine (React Hook Form Core)
concept: Uncontrolled Refs with Event Subscriptions for High-Performance Forms
problemStatement: Implement `createFormEngine(initialValues)` that registers input fields via refs, tracks touched and dirty states, validates fields without re-rendering parent components, and returns serialized values on submit.
interviewTrap: Storing form values in top-level useState forces the entire form component tree to re-render on every keystroke. Using uncontrolled ref-based subscription isolated to inputs scales to thousands of inputs smoothly.

testCases.name: Updates field value on change without external rerenders
testCases.testFn: const form = createFormEngine(); const emailField = form.register('email'); emailField.onChange('alex@test.com'); return form.getValues();

testCases.name: Validates field and records error message
testCases.testFn: const form = createFormEngine(); const pass = form.register('password', val => val.length < 8 ? 'Too short' : null); pass.onChange('123'); return form.getErrors();

testCases.name: Accurately calculates overall form validity status
testCases.input: check isValid() when errors exist vs cleared
testCases.testFn: const form = createFormEngine(); const name = form.register('name', v => !v ? 'Required' : null); name.onChange('Antigravity'); return form.isValid();

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: A controlled component's single source of truth is React state; an uncontrolled component delegates state to the DOM node via a ref. Bridging both requires synchronizing internal fallback state with incoming prop state.
